title: Seeking Immortality in the Sect
summary: A seasonal multiplayer cultivation game. Join one of four sects, master unique arts, and shape your build. Fight World Bosses, explore realms, raise spirit pets, grow herbs, and brew pills. Seasons reset your progress, but pets, titles, and select rewards endure. Choose a new path each season.
about:
Every New Cycle, a New Path to Immortality.

This is a multiplayer cultivation game built around a seasonal cycle system.

Join one of four great sects and master its unique techniques, or challenge World Bosses to obtain the cultivation arts passed down by rival sects. Break through cultivation realms, explore secret realms, compete for resources, and seek rare opportunities to discover precious heavenly treasures.

Grow spirit herbs, brew pills, cultivate Five Elements spirit pets, and forge equipment for your companions. Study cultivation techniques and mental arts, experiment with different combinations, and develop a combat style of your own.

Swordsmanship, fire arts, thunder mastery, healing, defense... Every choice leads to a different path of cultivation.

There is no single prescribed path to immortality. Your cultivation path, combat style, and growth strategy are yours to decide.
Seasonal Rebirth — Begin Your Cultivation Anew

When a new season begins, every cultivator embarks on a fresh journey.

Character levels, equipment, treasures, spirit pet levels, pet equipment, cultivation techniques, mental arts, attribute bonuses from heavenly treasures, and other seasonal progression and regular resources will be reset. You will choose a sect again, rethink your cultivation strategy, and begin a new journey from the very beginning.

In your previous life, perhaps you wielded a sword to defeat your enemies. This time, why not command flames and thunder? Perhaps you once devoted yourself to offensive arts, but now choose to master healing and defensive techniques instead.

Different sect traditions, combinations of cultivation techniques and mental arts, and the heavenly treasures you discover each season will open up new possibilities. Every rebirth brings a fresh opportunity to experiment with builds and explore a different path to immortality.

But rebirth does not mean losing everything.

Spirit pets themselves, season rewards, tokens, titles, and other designated items will be permanently retained. The companions you have raised and the honors you have earned will remain with you throughout your many seasons of cultivation.
Four Great Sects, Four Unique Traditions

Each of the four great sects has its own starting mental arts and progression paths. Choose your tradition, master its elemental techniques, and gradually develop your own combat style.

Wenjian Mountain — The Sword That Cuts Through All Things

Wenjian Mountain specializes in sword techniques that deal powerful non-elemental armor-piercing damage. Its sword arts excel at both single-target and area attacks. With the unique armor-piercing properties of sword techniques, cultivators can penetrate enemy defenses and unleash devastating non-elemental damage against even the toughest opponents.

Chixiao Sect — Master of Flame and Thunder

Chixiao Sect specializes in Fire and Metal techniques. Fire arts excel at area damage and burning enemies, allowing cultivators to overwhelm groups with blazing flames. Metal arts harness the power of thunder, using Shock, Paralysis, and Stun effects to disrupt and control opponents, keeping the battle firmly in your hands.

Shanhai Sect — The Strength of Earth, the Grace of Water

Water techniques specialize in healing and beneficial effects, providing vital support to yourself and your allies. Earth techniques focus on defense, allowing cultivators to withstand powerful attacks with an unshakable foundation. They can also convert their own defensive power into damage, balancing offense and defense.

Shenmu Valley — The Ever-Growing Power of Nature

Shenmu Valley focuses exclusively on Wood techniques. Its cultivators excel at controlling enemies, weakening groups of opponents, and healing allies. By combining control and support abilities, they can dictate the pace of battle and turn the tide at crucial moments.
